title: Q5
description:
“Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt.”
Read: Exo 24:3–8, Jer 31:32
a) Jeremiah says, “My covenant which they broke.” What does that bring forward about where the failure lay: in the covenant, or in the people (Heb 8:8, “finding fault with them”)?
